methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: iHub open house invites community to explore innovation and technology - norfolkneradio.com
signals.signal_reading: Community-facing innovation hub open houses signal grassroots technology engagement in a non-metro region, suggesting distributed peer learning networks could develop beyond traditional tech corridors if sustained.

signals.title: Norfolk Police Department E911 Division implements AI system for non-emergency calls - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: Municipal AI adoption for E911 non-emergency calls represents shallow, platform-delivered implementation—operational efficiency without deep capability building, typifying distributed but surface-level adoption patterns.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: AI Ready Roanoke initiative demonstrates deliberate capability assessment in a smaller metro area, potentially building deep local expertise through community evaluation rather than waiting for top-down platform deployment.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon's data center cancellation due to local backlash reveals concentration tensions—NoVA remains the infrastructure gravity well even as communities resist, reinforcing metro-focused AI capability rather than dispersing it.

signals.title: Spanberger releases Moving Virginia Forward agenda, tackling issues of affordability and AI - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Gubernatorial candidate's statewide AI agenda acknowledges the technology gap as a policy problem, but without mechanisms for distributed capability building, awareness alone may reinforce existing concentration patterns.
